title: 7.2 Spam Confidence
prompt: 7.2 Write a program that prompts for a file name, then opens that file and reads through the file, looking for lines of the form X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.8475. Count these lines and compute the average. Do not use the sum() function. The autograder will provide the file name mbox-short.txt as input.
learning_objective: Scan a mailbox file for confidence lines and compute their average without sum().
hint: Skip lines that do not start with X-DSPAM-Confidence:, float the second word, and average total/count.
solution_explanation: Only X-DSPAM-Confidence: lines contribute. Convert the numeric token with float(), accumulate a total and count, then print total/count as the average.

student.py.starter:
# Use the file name mbox-short.txt as the file name
fname = input("Enter file name: ")
fh = open(fname)
for line in fh:
    if not line.startswith("X-DSPAM-Confidence:"):
        continue
    print(line)
print("Done")
student.py.solution:
# Use the file name mbox-short.txt as the file name
fname = input("Enter file name: ")
fh = open(fname)
tot = 0.0
count = 0
for line in fh:
    if not line.startswith("X-DSPAM-Confidence:") : continue
    words = line.split()
    tot = tot + float(words[1])
    count = count + 1
print("Average spam confidence:", tot/count)
